review_design: Root image-operation record plus another agent text/coordinate/operational review. This is not two independent image observations.
exposure: Same informed AI, old labels/results/images exposed. This draft reads frozen old texts only; does not certify any pixels.
new_observation_status: All current/new-image support fields await the frozen root observation. No new Q, signature, H/H4 or case selection is supplied.

mapping_category_definitions.EXPLICIT_OLD_G_TO_CASE: Only the already frozen F03 shared cap-group case correspondence, including unchanged lower records within those complete cases. Does not extend to side/red remainders.
mapping_category_definitions.CONDITIONAL_LOCAL_CASE_ONLY: Old local case or identity support may be cited under its original conditions, but there is no explicit complete common-g operation at this record granularity. It is not a new g mapping.
mapping_category_definitions.UNMAPPABLE_AT_CURRENT_UNIT_GRANULARITY: Missing parent/route/identity/exclusion ledger or unresolved aggregate prevents a unit-specific mapping. Retain uncertainty without inventing IDs.

C: An actually traceable nonbranching path from a body/join port to a naturally bounded Z.
Original-coordinate path plus two separated transverse boundary witnesses OR explicit single-stroke evidence.
An interrupted aligned fragment is not certified continuity; no new Z at arbitrary color/width changes.
Z: Separately supported bounded distal cap or first delimited attachment region.
A Z label, one port or local Q0 does not itself establish an upper free endpoint.
A broad multi-port region does not imply hidden interior connectivity.
T: Own visible free endpoint and continuous direct path from Z, with two-boundary or explicit single-stroke evidence, possibly via preserved canonical alias.
No intermediate visible J or unresolved B; a route only to an opaque boundary remains distinct from a witnessed paper-exposed free end.
Shared route is one physical identity; never counted twice or assigned to two incompatible parents.
Q0_Q1: Q0 needs relevant perimeter/attachment exclusion of qualifying T.
Q1 needs one independently qualified T plus local exclusion of a second.
Not-certified T is not nonexistent route; local lower Q0 is not proof of an upper T.
J: At least three separate channel arms with actual local continuity.
Two sides of one outline are not two arms; crossing or broad body ports alone do not certify J.
B_P: Keep the visible boundary/envelope and actual incident ports.
No inferred hidden skeleton or internal routing through opaque fill.
Retain B/Z aliases with separately supported local incidences.
IDENTITY: Keep complete cases, all aliases, at_most_one, ownership and shared-tail exclusions.
Do not split coupled F02 fan alternatives, three F03 cap-role choices, or F06 brown membership into independent choices.
Already counted C-Z/J and selected child traces excluded from residual cannot reappear as new extras.
